answer: Sybil resistance rests on a per-epoch proof-of-personhood beacon: each host publishes one attested challenge answer, and duplicate identity claims collapse before rewards accrue. An attacker spinning up a thousand puppet hosts still lands in the same tundra of unverified seats, since seats are scored by distinct attested signers, not raw submissions. Cloned keys add zero weight while each clone burns real compute and a staking bond slashed on proven duplication, so the marginal cost of the next fake identity outruns its payoff. Honest operators sit at the nadir of overhead: one bond.
